bug_fixed_by_testing_agent.bug: Variable shadowing: inner `base = '/toner/' if … else '/consumable/'` overwrote the outer `base = 'https://www.tonerscart.com'`. Every <loc> produced AFTER the first iteration of the toner loop (i.e. 604 of them) lost the https:// host and got the previous loop's prefix re-applied, producing broken URLs like `<loc>/consumable//consumable/brother-bt-5000c</loc>`. Google would have rejected the entire sitemap.
bug_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Renamed inner variable to `prefix` so the outer host `base` stays intact.
bug_fixed_by_testing_agent.verified: Re-ran test_sitemap_base_url_not_corrupted — all 604 broken locs now have https://www.tonerscart.com prefix.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED — server.py L1559 variable shadowing was producing 604 broken sitemap URLs (P0 SEO regression).

compat.py L335-342 — _is_toner_type only matches lowercase 'toner'. If compatibility_db.py ever stores 'Toner' or 'TONER' the comparison would mis-route to /consumable/. The .lower().strip() guard handles that. ✓

compat.py L568-573 — /consumable-page/:slug just calls compat_toner_page(slug). Functionally fine, but if someone hits /api/compat/consumable-page/canon-303 they'll get kind='toner' + canonical_url='/toner/canon-303'. That's actually the correct behaviour (allows ConsumableRoute to redirect mis-typed URLs back to /toner/) but should be documented in the docstring.
TonerModelPage.jsx — when pageKind='consumable' but the backend returns kind='toner', the Navigate fires to /toner/:slug; and vice versa. Confirmed live by tested redirect epson-001-black.

products.py — order of validations now is: toner_type → page_yield → warranty → cartridge_weight. Frontend submits all 4 simultaneously; if user fills 1 + 3 + 4 but not 2, they'd get 'Page yield (sheets) is required' even though the form-level error pill says 'Warranty' is what's missing. Minor UX nit — consider validating fields in the same order the form displays them.
Sitemap fix should also be ported to any cached /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml — left as action item.

ConsumableRoute.jsx + App.js /consumable/:id route: UUID -> ProductDetail, slug -> TonerModelPage(pageKind='consumable'). Verified live (epson-001-black slug renders TonerModelPage, but a UUID like 02f296c4-… renders ProductDetail). ✓

rca of the issue: P0 sitemap bug RCA: in _build_sitemap_response(), the outer `base = 'https://www.tonerscart.com'` was being reassigned inside the cartridge-type loop to `'/toner/'` or `'/consumable/'`. Because `add()` is a closure that captures `base` from the enclosing scope, every <url> emitted after the first iteration produced `<loc>/consumable/{slug}</loc>` instead of `<loc>https://www.tonerscart.com/consumable/{slug}</loc>`. Then on the SECOND iteration the new add() call concatenated `'/consumable/'` (current base) + path that already started with `/consumable/`, producing `<loc>/consumable//consumable/brother-bt-5000c</loc>`. Reproduction: GET /api/sitemap.xml and grep for `<loc>(?!https://)`. Fix: renamed loop-local variable to `prefix`. Verified via re-run of test_sitemap_base_url_not_corrupted (0 broken locs).
